name: Magic Hour
tagline: Create and edit images and video with Magic Hour.
description: Connect Cline to Magic Hour for AI image and video creation and editing, project status, uploads, and finished-media downloads. Tool calls require a Magic Hour API key. Generation spends Magic Hour credits; check account access and obtain approval before generation.

install.notes: Replace <magic_hour_api_key> with your own key from https://magichour.ai/developer?tab=api-keys in the installation wizard or MCP settings before calling tools. Keep the key private. Call get_account_info to verify API access before spending credits. Save returned project IDs and use the matching wait_for_*_project tool to retrieve completed media.
